title: lint: the publish-time null-guard gate still excludes flow and edge conditions, so an unguarded ordering comparison on a nullable field ships and faults at run time
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① class (c) out-of-scope finding of the #28951 dev (os-dev-report 6570437242), filed by `domain:server` seat 5 for the `domain:devx` lane (`packages/lint`). Graded by this seat: p3, a gate gap with a named producer. Graded under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any author or AI writing a flow `condition` (an edge or a start condition) that orders a nullable field (`budget > 200000` on an optional currency field).
Reader who acts: the `domain:devx` seat (`packages/lint/src/validate-null-guards.ts`).

## What happens

The showcase's `showcase_project_escalation` e2 (`budget > 200000` on the optional `showcase_project.budget`) passed `os validate` on `main` and faulted at run time: `no such overload: dyn‹null› > int`, a terminal run failure (#28951, fixed in the flow by PR #29018). `validate-null-guards.ts` still lists flow / edge `condition` as an excluded surface in its ledger. Its totality blocker is gone since #4953, and the widening card #4811 is closed.

Measured beside it: `has(record.X)` is true on a declared-but-null key, because the run's `record` is total over declared fields. So the `has()` guard authors reach for does not guard; `record.X != null` does, and the gate already accepts it as dominating.

## Wanted

- Bring flow `condition` surfaces (edges, start conditions, decision conditions) under the null-guard gate with the same rule and remedy text as its other surfaces. Or answer why they stay excluded.
- Consider whether the remedy should name `!= null` over `has()` for this reason.
- Fixture fallout in examples and dogfood flows is part of the card. Measure it first.

Dedupe: searched `null-guard flow condition`; none open. **New.**

Links back: #28951, PR #29018, #4953, #4811.
